title: What It Actually Looks Like to Stay Humble While Still Leading
caption:
Everyone talks about humble leadership. Almost nobody shows you what it costs.

It costs taking the correction from a younger man instead of explaining it away. It costs saying someone else's name louder than your own. It costs training a guy good enough to replace you, on purpose.

Christ led from a towel and a basin before He led from anywhere else. Kneel first. Lead second.

#faith #leadership #humility #godlyman #christianmen
